# BoringQuantSystems

> Boring means trustworthy.

A machine-made house: exact, reproducible engines for markets.

## Engines

- [nanobook](https://github.com/BoringQuantSystems/nanobook): Rust execution layer for Python trading strategies: order book, backtests, pre-trade risk

## Houses

- [machine-made](https://machine-made.github.io/): the umbrella over every house
- [openfluids](https://openfluids.github.io/): open tools for fluid mechanics

An open-source workshop. Built by agents, guided by humans.
